## Maintainer ruling — the per-type table · 2026-11-08T15:37Z

⛔ Not a claim. Ruling-ref: the decision card cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XXcuUzfgeP6JVoqNvDUzLQu, where the maintainer tapped **A 「按修正后分档写入」** at 2026-11-08T15:36:01Z. The tap record cannot be attached, so the card id and time are the reference. The ruling answers his message cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XJTUSUfKPA7PtpFv3yqsrYs 「流程等行为元数据按软件包寻址，立决策卡，现在就所有的元数据类型然后和我沟通。」 It also follows the direction ruling recorded on #30806 (6721941146). The inventory it rests on was measured at `86e37660`.

The table below replaces this card's "Per-type scope: pending" section, and the card body is updated to match. Stage 2, the ADR, is unblocked.

## Principle
Storage identity and data contracts keep the global literal prefix. Behavioural and presentation metadata are identified by (package, name). Environment-authored items belong to the implicit environment package and need only be unique within the environment.

## Bucket 1 — global literal prefix, unchanged
object (ADR-0129 D2, table name) · field · object_extension · view (object-derived) · capability (NS.SHORT, ruling 6683456244) · doc (ADR-0046 doc lint) · api PATH (globally unique; the api item NAME is bucket 2).

## Bucket 2 — identity (package, name); runtime addresses by package (20 types)
flow · action (objectName:name plus package) · hook · job (align `jobKeyFor` to the package coordinate) · webhook · mapping · connector · permission (set) · sharing_rule · queue · assignment_rule · app · page · dashboard · report · dataset · analytics_cube · picklist · email_template (hotcrm's already prefixed names need no rename) · book.

## Bucket 3 — identity (package, name) plus a derived flat name on the AI/MCP face
tool · skill · agent · rag_pipeline; the #31515 action tool name (`action_<bare>`) joins here. MCP requires unique tool/prompt names per server, so the face spelling is derived from namespace + name (ADR-0028 "derived physical names"); the exact spelling is this card's decision.

## Bucket 4 — environment-authored rows
datasource mostly, and every customer-authored item: package null = implicit environment package; bare name unique in the environment; no rename, no migration.

## POSITION — environment-scoped (chosen over "all three security types package-keyed")
One org chart per environment. Packages contribute positions; the same name is the same slot. Conflict handling (keep the phase-1 one-holder refusal, or merge the contributions) is this card's decision. Approval routing `position:NAME` and sharing recipients therefore carry no package.

## Exceptions to state in the ADR
- PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES (today only permission set `guest_portal`): the platform asks by spelling and declares no dependency, so these resolve environment-wide with ONE holder; the phase-1 refusal stays for them.
- `sys` is the reserved kernel package (ADR-0028 TL;DR 5); platform metadata belongs to it.

## Resolution rule (buckets 2 and 3)
same package → unique holder in the declared dependency closure (ADR-0141) → otherwise refuse with the candidate list (reuse `bare-name-one-holder.ts` vocabulary). By-name URLs accept an optional package segment (`/automation/crm/send_email`); a bare name keeps resolving while unique in the environment and answers 409 with candidates otherwise. Stored references gain a package column beside the name (no re-encoded literal, ADR-0126 §4), backfilled from the phase-1 holder; the sealed ambiguity set is left unrewired and reported.

## Maintainer ruling — ADR-0150 open questions Q1 and Q2 · 2026-11-08T16:30Z

⛔ Not a claim. Ruling-ref: decision card cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XX2ScaRkjtxxoSRmu1t8H2p. The maintainer tapped **option 0 「A+A，含对象动作补充」** at 2026-11-08T16:30:25Z. The tap record cannot be attached, so the card id and time are the reference.

- **Q1 = A, with the object-action refinement.** A bucket-3 item's AI/MCP face name is `NS-NAME`: the namespace, a hyphen, then the name. Past 64 characters it is cut to 55, then a hyphen and 8 hex characters of a hash of the full identity are appended. **An object-bound action spells `OBJECT-ACTION`** (for example `crm_lead-convert_lead`): one package may bind the same action name to several objects (the #5510 dedup reading), and the object name already carries the global prefix. Object-less actions, and tool, skill, agent and rag_pipeline, use `NS-NAME`. The cloud action tool (#31515) derives its name from the same function.
- **Q2 = A.** A position name that two packages ship keeps the one-holder refusal. An administrator binds another package's permission set to a position through an ADR-0005 overlay of that position. No merge engine.
- **Unblocked:** child P (face derivation), G2 (MCP face names), and cloud #31515.
- **Still with the maintainer:** ADR-0150 D2, uniqueness of behavioural names across a namespace's co-owners, which is child N.

ADR-0150 (#31586) is being amended to record both answers as decided.

## Maintainer ruling — ADR-0150 open question Q3 · 2026-11-08T17:13Z

⛔ Not a claim. Ruling-ref: decision card cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6PpcgtPh7CFuE3r19ikYrV. The maintainer tapped **A 「安装时拒绝」** at 2026-11-08T17:13:30Z. The tap record cannot be attached, so the card id and time are the reference.

- **Q3 = A.** A namespace may never equal an object name. The rule is refused **in both directions** (a new namespace equal to an existing object name; a new object name equal to an existing namespace) at **every object door**: `defineStack`, `os validate`, install and Studio publish. Both spellings appear in the refusal.
- Riders, as put to him and not objected to: a face is cut only past 64 characters; the face list refuses duplicates; an `action_*` namespace against the cloud `action_` tool prefix falls under the same refusal. Corollary: no package ships an object whose short name is `custom`, because the ADR-0146 pair namespace is `NS_custom`.
- The Q1 spelling stands as ruled (6724050556).
- **Still with the maintainer:** D2 (child N).

- **D2 accepted.** Identity is the package id; the address is the namespace. Packages that share a namespace keep each behavioural `(type, name)` unique across it, so a qualified address names exactly one item. Child N carries the refusal: a declared narrowing, measured 0 of 297 on HotCRM. `?package=` stays as the exact qualifier.
- This closes every open question on ADR-0150: Q1 and Q2 (6724050556), Q3 (6724530715), D2 (this record).
